newsitem.title: USA: Group has 5.1 pct stake in HFNC Financial.
newsitem.headline: Group has 5.1 pct stake in HFNC Financial.

text.p: A group including South Carolina investor Jerry Zucker said Tuesday it holds a 5.1 percent stake or 875,000 common shares of HFNC Financial Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 602,500 shares between July 15 and September 13 at $15.875 to $18 per share.
The group said it holds the stake in the Charlotte, N.C., company for investment and "to take actions" which may enhance the value of the securities as an investment.
Other members of the group are Jerry Shearer, Mid-Atlantic Investors and Mid-Atlantic Partners LP.
